test_title: PYST 63: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held  On 28 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution’.

__Half of the property given__ to his sons by the businessman last year.

options.text: Half of the property is given
Half of the property was given
Half of the property has been given

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The original sentence is in the past tense, indicating an action completed in the past.
 
• The use of** "was given"** correctly aligns with the past tense context of the sentence.
 
• **"Is given" **or **"has been given"** would incorrectly imply a present or ongoing action.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

**Correct Sentence:** *"**Half of the property** was given to his sons by the businessman last year."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **No substitution** – This option would be correct if the original sentence was already in the past tense, but it is not.
 
• **Half of the property is given** – This option incorrectly uses the present tense, which does not match the context of the sentence.
 
• **Half of the property has been given** – This option incorrectly implies an action that may continue into the present.
